title: Initials from a name
prompt: Add an exported function initials(name: string): string to src/names.ts. It returns the uppercase first letter of each word in the name, where words are separated by spaces or hyphens, so initials("mary-jane van der berg") is "MJVDB". Extra spaces are ignored and an empty or blank name gives an empty string.
acceptance: Spaces and hyphens separate words, uppercase, extra spaces ignored, blank gives empty string.
